set.body: Implement truly bounded replay using the existing Stepwise runner, with wrapper in io to respect module direction. Whole-trial Scanpath/StudyInput and AdmissionLedger construction are known unbounded operations. Core decision #26 must choose incremental validation prerequisite or validated-input route before implementation. Require equivalence and deterministic cancellation evidence.
set.title: Ledger S2: bounded verification execution and cancellation
